name: Jem
self_text: Coming from a biology background, I've always been drawn to the natural world, which is why I spend my free time birdwatching. Lately, I have been focusing on language practice. A typical session for me involves studying independently side by side in person, with occasional short exchanges. I find this quiet productivity very grounding. I am available on Saturday afternoons for this.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into language practice. It's a deal-breaker unless you are okay with complete silence while working or occasional short exchanges. Ideally, we overlap on in person, but no big deal.
